ResearchProjectDef.label: skill implants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build high-tech implants that increase a pawn's skill. Requires a skilled doctor to implant.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Archotech Limbs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Regular Archotech Limbs are the most basic form of Archotech Bionics, more advanced and specialised versions exist.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Archotech Implants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Archotech Implants enhance the base performance of a body part to almost incomprehnsible standards.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Archotech Organs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Archotech Organs are the peak of Bionic engineering and offer the best performance out of all artificial body parts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Archotech Bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Archotech Bionics are notoriously hard to reverse engineer, but should you succeed, a whole new world of Bionic engineering awaits you.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Archotech Skeletal Enhancement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enhancing the Skeletal structure to Archotech standards allows one to use Archotech Limbs to their full potential.
